description: The Department of the Navy, Naval Information Warfare Center Pacific (NIWC Pacific) hereby publicizes its intention to solicit, negotiate, and award a Firm-Fixed-Price purchase order on a noncompetitive basis to Trellisware Technologies Inc. (Trellisware). The requirement is for the purchase of the following items listed below: Software and Test Support, Qty: 1, and ODC Travel, Qty: 1. This notice of intent is NOT a request for quote nor a request for information. A determination by the Government not to compete based upon responses to this notice is solely at the discretion of the government. The applicable NAICS Code is 334220 ? Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing, and the business size standard is 1250 employees. Acquisition of Commercial Items under RFO FAR Part 13 ? Simplified Procedures for Noncommercial Acquisitions. The point of contact for this announcement is Paolo Mendoza at paolo.r.mendoza.civ@us.navy.mil. Be advised that the aforementioned information is anticipatory in nature and is not binding. Any comments, questions or concerns regarding this notice may be submitted via e-mail to paolo.r.mendoza.civ@us.navy.mil by 1 April 2026 at 1200 PST. Questions by phone or fax will not be considered.
